claims.claim: Nike Factory Store, Outlets at Castle Rock is open and serves as the Mile High Code door
claims.evidence: Nike's Colorado store directory lists a Nike Factory Store at 5050 Factory Shops Blvd #905, Castle Rock, at the Outlets at Castle Rock, with current opening hours. The center sits off I-25 between Denver and Colorado Springs.

claims.claim: Nike Factory Store, Denver Premium Outlets (Thornton) is open
claims.evidence: The same Nike directory lists a Nike Factory Store at Denver Premium Outlets in Thornton. It also lists Nike doors in Lakewood and Northfield and a Nike Clearance Store in Aurora, so Nike's metro footprint is wider than the two outlets the brief names.

claims.claim: The Nuggets Team Store at Ball Arena operates as the launch door for scarce drops
claims.evidence: Ball Arena's team store page lists Altitude Authentics off Chopper Circle on the arena's south side, open Monday to Saturday, selling Avalanche, Nuggets and Mammoth merchandise. The page shows no date.

claims.claim: Denver won its 2023 title at home, the anniversary the June Skyline Heirloom drop rests on

sources.title: denver nuggets defeat miami heat to win first nba championship

claims.evidence: NBC reports Denver beat Miami 94-89 in Game 5 at Ball Arena for the franchise's first title, a 4-1 series. The clincher was a Monday game. The result does not print the June 12 date itself.

claims.claim: CRUSH Walls is the RiNo Art District's September mural festival and a 2027 partner for a live Nuggets wall
claims.evidence: Westword reports the RiNo Art District severed all ties with CRUSH Walls in 2020. A separate Westword piece covers a different RiNo mural event, Denver Walls. The search found no 2025 or 2026 CRUSH Walls edition.
claims.action: Split CRUSH Walls from the RiNo Art District in the strategy partners, made the 2027 wall conditional on CRUSH still running, and reworded the September 2027 reveal and art and culture dossier lines so they don't depend on CRUSH Walls.
